# OSGi Encryption

> Wraps the Jasypt encryption library as OSGi Declarative Services components, providing encrypt/decrypt/digest operations as registered OSGi services with ConfigAdmin integration, JMX monitoring, and Apache Karaf shell commands.

Key facts:
- Java 11 (source/target), build requires Java 21
- Maven 3.9.4+ multi-module project, 6 modules
- OSGi Core 6.0.0 with Declarative Services 1.3 and ConfigAdmin
- Jasypt 1.9.2 for PBE encryption and message digesting
- Apache Karaf 4.4.7 runtime with feature descriptor for one-command installation
- Pax Exam 4.13.5 integration tests booting a full Karaf container
- License: Apache 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Quick start guide and Karaf installation instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Project architecture, build commands, module descriptions, and development guide
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Development environment setup, code conventions, PR submission
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): Branching strategy, version numbering, CI/CD pipeline details

## Modules — Core

- [osgi-encryption-services/pom.xml](osgi-encryption-services/pom.xml): Core encryption/decryption/digest service implementations as OSGi DS components with Jasypt backend, password file watching, and BouncyCastle provider registration
- [osgi-encryption-metrics/pom.xml](osgi-encryption-metrics/pom.xml): JMX MBean provider that tracks encryption operation statistics and exposes them for monitoring

## Modules — Karaf Integration

- [osgi-encryption-karaf-commands/pom.xml](osgi-encryption-karaf-commands/pom.xml): Apache Karaf shell commands (`jasypt:encrypt`, `jasypt:decrypt`, `jasypt:digest`, `jasypt:info`) with tab completers
- [osgi-encryption-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](osgi-encryption-karaf-features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature XML descriptor that installs SCR, Jasypt dependencies, and runtime bundles

## Modules — Testing

- [osgi-encryption-test/pom.xml](osgi-encryption-test/pom.xml): Sample DS component demonstrating encrypted configuration usage
- [osgi-encryption-itest/pom.xml](osgi-encryption-itest/pom.xml): Pax Exam integration tests that boot a Karaf container with the encryption feature installed

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): Main CI pipeline for build, test, deploy, tag, and release
